articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Enhanced Reasoning and Multimodal Capabilities
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native multimodal input/output across text, image, audio, and video, and a larger effective context window. Benchmarks show step-change improvements in complex math, code generation, and scientific reasoning tasks, narrowing the gap with specialized domain models.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's latest Gemini 2.5 model has topped SWE-Bench Verified and HumanEval-Agent benchmarks, demonstrating an ability to autonomously plan, write, test, and debug multi-file codebases. The model introduces a persistent workspace memory that lets it maintain context across extended multi-step engineering tasks, pushing AI-assisted software development closer to practical autonomy.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Fremont Factory
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots on select assembly line stations at its Fremont, California plant. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for dynamic task adaptation, handling bin-picking and cable routing tasks previously requiring human workers.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Pilot to Full Body Shop Operations
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the expansion of its partnership with BMW, moving beyond the initial pilot to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across full body shop operations at the Spartanburg plant. The robots now perform welding inspection, parts transfer, and quality assurance tasks, with Figure reporting a 3x improvement in operational uptime since the initial deployment phase.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Workspaces' for Persistent AI-Assisted Engineering Teams
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Workspaces, a new product tier enabling engineering teams to create persistent, shared AI environments with long-term project memory, integrated code repositories, and fine-grained access controls. The feature targets enterprise software teams and supports continuous context across sessions, aiming to make AI a stateful collaborator rather than a stateless tool.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) gate-all-around nanosheet process at its Kaohsiung fab, marking a major inflection point in semiconductor scaling. The node offers approximately 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, with Apple and Nvidia among the first customers expected to tape out designs later this year.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Logical Qubit Error Rates Below Fault-Tolerance Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly published results showing their latest trapped-ion quantum system sustaining logical qubit error rates below 10⁻⁶ across extended computation cycles, clearing a key fault-tolerance threshold. The achievement uses Microsoft's Floquet color codes and moves practical quantum error correction from theoretical milestone to engineering reality, potentially accelerating the timeline for useful quantum computation.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union has initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta on transparency, safety testing, and systemic risk documentation requirements. The audits mark the practical onset of the world's most comprehensive AI regulation framework and are being closely watched as a template for governance approaches in other jurisdictions.
